description: Per 300m window with pack spawns. Level and distance ramps. Cap is a ceiling, not a fill quota.

stagger.note: Most slots are a single zombie. Occasional packs of 2–5 sit ~110px apart so slash/jump still work. First encounter after 48m.

levelRamp.note: Each level adds +1% more zombies per 300 meters relative to the prior level baseline.

distanceRamp.note: Every 150m, raise spawn rate per 300m of all zombies except drones by 1.2% (compounding).

rules: Each level: +1% more zombies per 300m vs previous level.
Spawn in packs of random 1–5 at the preferred spacing intervals (allow closer within a pack).
Every 150m traveled: multiply non-drone spawn rates by 1.012.
